decision: Treat agent/pro-responsibility-handoff at c1fc568424facbb5bb8e1b6369d30a1f380ae308 as the verified implementation and commission basis for this PRO pass; use agent/pro-grounding for reversible governance and build work.
why: The PR branch contains the latest governing handoff and differs materially from default main. Product and architecture conclusions must be reproducible from one exact code basis.
alternatives_rejected: assume default main is current
inherit branch claims without code inspection
continue only in conversational memory
consequences: Every worker must verify its exact base commit
Later code changes require checkpoint reconciliation
nonclaims: This does not independently reproduce the reported 115-test result
reversible_by: A later ledger entry naming a newly inspected commit and reconciliation receipt.

decision: Adopt docs/pro/PRO_CONSTITUTION.md as the governing product, evidence, and authority boundary for the experimental public-repository slice.
why: The existing interface and role topology are implementation evidence, while the mature product centre is an ongoing modelling and research environment that preserves leverage and makes consequential support, change, correction, dependency, and exact artifact use reconstructable.
alternatives_rejected: preserve Campaign Studio or the Casebook as product truth
treat Excel as the universal ontology
treat the practitioner signal as a validated feature taxonomy
consequences: Every visible product fact must map to canonical state and a consequence
Candidate state remains provisional until deterministic and scoped human conditions hold
nonclaims: No analyst has approved the constitution or product form
reversible_by: An explicit outer-speaker correction or a later evidence-backed product adjudication recorded with scope.

decision: Retain the existing ownership, exact-byte custody, run-specification, work-order, NTM/Codex, provisional output, restart, and Langfuse spine; do not begin with a wholesale prompt rewrite or additional agent roles.
why: The active protocols already express useful epistemic discipline. The reproduced failure occurs because the model authors most source semantics and the host lacks a source-assertion-to-target gate, not because the prompts fail to mention provenance.
alternatives_rejected: activate the dormant DeepResearch suite first
add a provenance critic agent
add fields to a model-authored candidate and call the problem solved
replace the runtime with a new orchestration framework
consequences: The first production seam must be host-owned
Prompt changes remain downstream of typed source, target, proposal, and artifact operations
nonclaims: The retained substrate is not production-ready and does not establish research quality
reversible_by: A code-backed experiment showing that a retained mechanism prevents the selected slice or imposes greater total burden than a simpler alternative.

decision: Do not adopt Agentic SDLC as the analyst product architecture. Trial only its durable reconstitution and run-record concepts for fresh Codex engineering work, with Git and PostgreSQL remaining canonical.
why: The donor's artifact bus and session rebuild address context recovery, but its software-development stages, closed taxonomy, overwrite-in-place files, subagent topology, and deferred enforcement would distort or weaken this product.
alternatives_rejected: install the donor harness wholesale
make the filesystem artifact tree canonical
expose recipes or agent stages to analysts
reject every donor pattern without experiment
consequences: The first worker packet also serves as the reconstitution experiment
No donor mechanism changes product state automatically
nonclaims: The donor repository was not evaluated as a complete production SDLC system
reversible_by: The discriminating experiment's kill condition or a later measured coordination comparison.

decision: Select an artifact-native model-update companion as the first falsifiable product form: Excel remains the native work product, while one ongoing job owns exact source capture, target contracts, proposals, deterministic admission, candidate workbook versions, recalculation evidence, exceptions, history, and scoped permission to rely.
why: A full integrated spreadsheet workspace duplicates Excel before the core risk is proven. A generic research-job hub risks another abstract dashboard. The companion reuses the current backend, completes one recognisable model-update job, and exposes only consequential changes and exceptions.
alternatives_rejected: integrated spreadsheet replacement as the first slice
provenance or research dashboard without native artifact change
generic durable job hub as the primary first interface
static Excel review
consequences: The smallest coherent UI is job creation plus one model-update workspace
Workbook patch and supported recalculation are release prerequisites, not later polish
The mature product form remains open after the experiment
nonclaims: This is not analyst validation or a commitment to an Excel-only product
reversible_by: Kill or redesign if workbook support is bespoke, review approaches manual reconstruction, or the source gate overblocks legitimate work.

decision: Use Micron FY2025 consolidated GAAP revenue as the public semantic counterexample, with evidence cutoff 2025-10-04: the agent initially references the 2025-09-23 8-K EX-99.1 earnings release for 37,378 USDm, while the versioned target contract requires the 2025-10-03 10-K carrying the same value.
why: The case isolates admissibility from numerical correctness. Both documents are official SEC artifacts for the same issuer and value; the target-specific document-class rule, not a slogan that GAAP always wins, determines admission.
alternatives_rejected: fictional source semantics as the only live case
a wrong numeric value that tests arithmetic rather than admissibility
a universal preference for GAAP or filings
attachment of the manual Micron report
consequences: The blocked proposal must create no candidate workbook
An attributed source replacement using the exact 10-K assertion must allow patch and recomputation
A separate test must prove that another target may permit EX-99.1 or non-GAAP authority
nonclaims: The target policy is a demo contract, not a universal sell-side rule or investment judgment
reversible_by: Discovery that the official source pair cannot be captured and distinguished deterministically, or analyst evidence that the configured rule is professionally wrong for the named target.

decision: Make a bounded workbook parse, patch, preservation, and recalculation capability spike the first Codex implementation packet; prohibit UI, prompt, agent, source-policy, and production-model work until the spike is reconciled.
why: The leading hypothesis fails if the repository cannot produce a verifiably recalculated candidate workbook without manually fabricating cached values or writing bespoke support for one file. That uncertainty should be resolved before adding domain objects or screens.
alternatives_rejected: draw the workspace first
implement source models before native artifact feasibility
claim open/save as recalculation
hard-code downstream outputs for the Micron fixture
consequences: PASS permits the source-target and candidate-artifact slices to begin
FAIL kills or reshapes the Excel companion before interface investment
A bounded truthful failure is an acceptable worker return
nonclaims: A passing purpose-built fixture would not prove support for typical sell-side workbooks
reversible_by: A PRO reconciliation of the capability receipt and code diff.

decision: Do not call any current or intermediate state a product demo. The claim ceiling remains an experimental build hypothesis until one ordinary authenticated path performs real NTM/Codex work, contains the Micron wrong-source proposal, applies an exact correction, recalculates and stores a candidate workbook, records scoped human disposition, survives restart, and preserves diagnostic receipts.
why: Mechanical tests, a capability spike, source schemas, attractive UI, or a high-quality report can each succeed while the causal product proposition remains untested.
alternatives_rejected: demo claim after green tests
demo claim after workbook spike
demo claim after static UI
demo claim from manual research attachment
consequences: Every slice must state its own nonclaims
Live-path receipts and analyst go/revise/kill questions are mandatory before external presentation
nonclaims: No current artifact establishes analyst usefulness, deployment readiness, research quality, or cumulative improvement
reversible_by: Only evidence satisfying the governing release standard and a later explicit ledger entry changing the claim ceiling.
